description:
The New Aeris 120 LT

Following in the footsteps of the Aeris 145 LT, the Aeris 120 LT gives you extra travel and a more aggressive stance. Using a revised linkage both increases the rear travel to 130mm and lowers the bottom bracket, while also increasing the amount of progression in the shock curve.
The Aeris 120 LT maximises the fun levels and is equally at home on local trails and uplift days. As an aggressive short travel bike it is both poppy and manoeuvrable, which makes it a total blast when ripping down the trails.

Aeris 120 LT is a more aggressive version of our do it all mountain bike that you can take anywhere.
It’s a bike that never feels like overkill on your local trails, but isn’t afraid of the black runs either. Trails centre loops, uplift days, long cross country rides and enduro racing – the Aeris 120 LT is a true one bike to rule them all.
Try Before You Buy? Aeris 120 LT Demo >>

We’ve rejigged the linkage to deliver 130mm of travel, and kick back the head angle for some good times. Paired with a 140mm fork sagged head angle drops to just the fun side of 66 degrees. 27.5 wheels, in nice wide 30 or 35mm options give you confident grip and comfort when paired with our 2.5 and 2.6 tyre options. Not one to shy from the rough stuff, the Aeris 120 LT will handle the roughest terrain with the maximum of confidence. Like all Bird bikes you have control over the specification of your bike. Whether you’re aiming for a lightweight XC machine, or an enduro slayer, the choice is yours from one of the industry’s leading customisation programs. The 120 LT features all the good stuff from modern MTB standards, and none of the fluff.

Buy with confidence knowing that we’ve got your back. Not only do you get one of the best warranties in the business, but you also get our award winning customer service. Whatever you need, we’re here for you. Any questions? Give us a call on 0333 444 0650 or email us.
